resources.string: LinguaAI accessibility service. Reads the text you are editing in other apps (WhatsApp, Gmail, Messages, etc.) so it can provide grammar, spelling, vocabulary, tone, and rewrite suggestions through a floating overlay. No text is stored — analysis happens on demand and is sent only to the LinguaAI API.
LinguaAI is running — analyzing your writing across apps
Accessibility service is OFF — tap to enable
Overlay permission is OFF — tap to enable
LinguaAI is active. The floating button will appear when you type in any app.
